# opnsense_telegraf_general (Resource)

Telegraf agent settings (**Services ▸ Telegraf ▸ General**, plugin `os-telegraf`): service, intervals, buffering and logging. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `telegraf_general` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_telegraf_general.this
  id = "telegraf_general"
}

resource "opnsense_telegraf_general" "this" {
  enabled  = true
  interval = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `collection_jitter` (Number) Collection jitter is used to jitter the collection by a random amount. Each plugin will sleep for a random time within jitter before collecting. Input value are seconds. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `debug` (Boolean) Log at debug level.
- `enabled` (Boolean) This will activate the telegraf agent.
- `flush_interval` (Number) Default flushing interval for all outputs. You should not set this below interval. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `flush_jitter` (Number) Jitter the flush interval by a random amount. This is primarily to avoid large write spikes for users running a large number of telegraf instances. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `hostname` (String) Override default hostname, if empty use system hostname.
- `interval` (Number) Default data collection interval for all inputs in seconds. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `metric_batch_size` (Number) Telegraf will send metrics to outputs in batches of at most metric_batch_size metrics. This controls the size of writes that Telegraf sends to output plugins. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `metric_buffer_limit` (Number) For failed writes, Telegraf will cache metric_buffer_limit metrics for each output, and will flush this buffer on a successful write. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `omit_hostname` (Boolean) If set to true, do no set the "host" tag in the Telegraf agent.
- `quiet` (Boolean) Log only error level messages.
- `roundinterval` (Boolean) Rounds collection interval to 'interval', e.g. if interval="10s" then always collect on :00, :10, :20, etc.
- `wheelgroup` (Boolean) This will start the process with wheel group and root user permission. Please use this with care, currently only needed for Unbound and Suricata.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `telegraf_settings`.
